title: An Intrinsic Formula for the Ray–West Correction Term
summary: For a nonempty permutation $\beta$ of length $m$, let $g_2(\beta)$ denote the number of distinct permutations of length $m+2$ containing $\beta$. Ray and West showed that $$ g_2(\beta)=\frac{m^4+2m^3+m^2+4m+4-2j(\beta)}{2}, \qquad 0\le j(\beta)\le m-1, $$ but their correction term was not expressed as a statistic of $\beta$. This was posed explicitly as Problem 3.7 by Vatter.
